hook: Heart Racing for No Reason? Do This First

voices.name: l00
voices.text: Is your heart racing right now, <#0.2#> for no reason at all?
voices.caption: Is your heart racing right now, for no reason at all?

voices.name: l01
voices.text: The doctor says you're fine, <#0.2#> but your body feels like it's always in an emergency.
voices.caption: The doctor says you're fine, but your body feels like it's always in an emergency.

voices.name: l02
voices.text: That's your nervous system, <#0.2#> running with no brakes.
voices.caption: That's your nervous system, running with no brakes.

voices.name: l03
voices.text: Try this. <#0.3#> Big breath in through your nose, <#0.3#> one more short sip on top, <#0.3#> then a long, slow exhale through your mouth.
voices.caption: Big inhale through the nose → one more short sip → long exhale through the mouth

voices.name: l04
voices.text: In a Stanford study, <#0.2#> five minutes a day of this improved mood the most.
voices.caption: Stanford study: 5 minutes a day, the biggest mood boost

voices.name: l05
voices.text: If it keeps happening, please see a doctor. <#0.2#> And for more on what your breath can change, watch the full video on the channel.
voices.caption: If it keeps happening, please see a doctor. And for more on what your breath can change, watch the full video on the channel.
